note: No booking at all: a newsletter and an enquiry receipt, full of dates and prices. Nothing is to be read as a booking.
text:
Spring in Portugal: our newsletter

Hello traveller,

Flights to Lisbon from EUR 59 return, travel between 1 March and 30 June 2027. Seats are limited.

Thank you for your enquiry (ref. ENQ-55120). This is not a booking. One of our advisers will write to you within 2 working days about hotels in Lisbon for 14-21 March 2027.

Top 3 spring events: the Flower Festival on 20 March at 11:00, the Tile Fair on 27 March, and the Night Market every Friday at 19:00.

You are receiving this because you signed up at newsletter.holidaylane.example. Unsubscribe at any time.
